verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents an in-client calendar: press 2 for a full calendar view, a side panel that shows your day when an email mentions a date, and consolidated Gmail/Outlook calendars you can toggle on and off. Scheduling is only implied, through "Find Time" and Team Scheduling availability views, and nothing in the evidence covers responding to invites. Scheduling meetings via MCP happens from an external AI assistant, not inside the client, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented in-client RSVP to invites, explicit in-client event creation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client

citations.quote: To see your full calendar, just hit 2 or tap the calendar icon. (And hit 1 to jump back to your inbox.)
When any email mentions a date, Superhuman Mail will show your day in the right side panel — so you always have context.
You can add all your Gmail and Outlook account calendars, and easily toggle them on and off. One single, consolidated view when you need it
Simply add teammates, click "Find Time", and instantly see when everyone is free.
